Tantra

Esoteric traditions using body, energy, and ritual as vehicles for spiritual transformation.

esotericenergytransformative

Overview

Tantra represents esoteric traditions found across Shaiva, Shakta, and Buddhist contexts. It emphasizes the body as a vehicle for liberation, the transformation of desire, and the awakening of subtle energies.

Key Ideas

  • 1The body is a microcosm of the universe
  • 2Energy (shakti/kundalini) as vehicle for awakening
  • 3What binds can also liberate when understood
  • 4Guru transmission is essential for authentic practice

Primary Practices

Mantra sadhanaKundalini practicesNyasa (sacred touch)Yantra meditation

Who It Suits

Serious seekers with stable foundations, those drawn to energy practices, and practitioners ready for systematic, guided work.

How to Start

Find a qualified teacher, develop stable meditation practice first, and approach with respect rather than sensationalism.
